commit 87209f805948bf13b8c26b3dde74c8f897918ee0
Author: Washington <contatxpriv@gmail.com>
Date:   Sat Jul 11 20:36:04 2026 -0300

    F6: CodeMirror 6 editor — syntax highlight while editing
    
    The file editor mounts CodeMirror (one-dark theme, line numbers,
    bracket matching, history, indent-with-tab) over the hidden textarea
    that remains the form field for the fetch save flow. Languages:
    Ruby/YAML via legacy-modes StreamLanguage; JS/TS, HTML/ERB, CSS, JSON
    and Markdown via dedicated packages. All vendored through importmap —
    no Node in the asset pipeline. Autocomplete stays out of this cut.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
